semantic_contract: inspect the stock user-access configuration through SP_EL0-derived state
mask the user address when the stock masked-access condition is active
reject addresses outside the stock 0x8000000000 and size boundary
temporarily switch TTBR0/TTBR1 with DAIF masked and restore both registers
invoke __arch_copy_from_user with the stock address mask
zero the uncopied tail and return the residual byte count
follow_up_required: Run privileged AArch64 execution only in a controlled kernel or emulator environment that can safely model TTBR and DAIF behavior.
Keep the host harness as the deterministic regression gate for failure, masking, bounds and partial-copy paths.
Run controlled NX809J runtime validation after the offline driver set is complete.
decision_basis: Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code, exact 61-instruction/244-byte AArch64 body and relocations, KCFI absence parity, strict Joern with zero unresolved calls, reproducible Docker build, and five-case two-cycle ASan/UBSan host contract. No smartphone test was performed.
